analysis.title: Flex (FLEX): Key takeaways from 2026 investor event; solutions and growth drivers in focus
key_insights: GS attended the Flex Innovation Event in Austin on 11/9-11/10. Flex plans to spin off its datacenter (CPI) business as a standalone company named Axiom in 1QCY27. Regulated Manufacturing (RMS) and Integrated Tech (ITS) stay with Flex as 'Remainco'.

GS maintains its Buy rating on FLEX with a 12m price target of $160 (from $159), 110.3% upside to the $76.09 price. The target uses 18x (from 19x, reflecting peer multiples) applied to Q5-Q8E EPS including SBC.

Management gave a CY27 Axiom revenue outlook of $20-$21bn (~111% y/y at the midpoint). Power is $6.0-$6.3bn (~76% y/y) and Cloud & Cooling is $14.0-$14.7bn (~131% y/y). Management said 95% of the CY27 Axiom revenue target is covered by backlog and customer commitments.

Axiom medium-term framework: revenue CAGR of 20%+ from CY27-30, with Power growing 40%+ and Cloud & Cooling growing 10%+. Management is selective on Cloud & Cooling programs to protect margin and capital returns, which is why that growth is not higher.

Axiom power content per megawatt is expected to rise from ~$2.8mn/MW to $3.4-$4.0mn/MW on greater uptake of 800VDC architectures. Management cited a 40%+ market CAGR through 2030 for custom compute and 30%+ for liquid cooling.

Axiom adjusted EBITDA margin is guided to the high-teens in CY30 from ~13.5% at the CY27 midpoint, with Power in the high-20s and Cloud & Cooling in the low-double-digits. Power is expected to be 2/3 of Axiom EBITDA by CY30 versus ~50% in CY27.

Remainco is targeting mid-single-digit organic revenue CAGR for FY26-29, with RMS growing mid-to-high single digits and ITS low-to-mid single digits. Six target markets (robotics, networking, parts of medical, satellite and others) rise from ~30% of Remainco revenue in FY27 to 35-40% in FY29 and grow double digits.

Remainco adjusted operating margin is targeted at 7%+ in FY29 from ~5.8% pro-forma at the FY27 guidance midpoint. The drivers are higher mix of high-value markets (margins at least 150bps above the segment average), productivity and fixed-cost leverage.

Cash flow targets: Remainco FY28-29 FCF conversion of 80%+ with capex ~2% of revenue and double-digit annual EPS growth. Axiom FCF is negative in CY26, then 40%+ of adjusted net income in CY27 and 90%+ in CY30, with capex falling from ~10% of revenue in CY26 to 3-4% in CY30.

Capital allocation prioritizes organic investment and selective M&A. Proceeds from a planned preferred equity offering go to deleveraging, and share repurchases will be opportunistic. Flex intends to sell its Axiom stake over time to reduce debt.

Management said its outlook factors in election-related datacenter uncertainty and conservatism, and that permits could take longer after the US election results. GS notes the CY27 CPI revenue outlook is modestly ahead of its forecast, though some investors had expected more upside before the mid-term election.
The RMS + ITS revenue framework through FY29 is about in line with GS expectations. The 7%+ EBIT margin is similar to the level GS expected, but the FY29 timing is earlier than previewed.
GS raised FY27/28/29 EPS (including SBC) to $4.55/$7.75/$9.50 from $4.55/$7.45/$8.75, on higher CPI revenue in FY28/29 and higher RMS and ITS margins. Excluding SBC it models $5.05/$8.25/$10.00.
FLEX shares are down 36.4% over 3 months and 46.5% over 6 months, but up 19.6% over 12 months.

market_movers.rationale: The event reinforced GS's view that Flex can grow earnings and FCF near term and over the medium to long term. The price target moved to $160 from $159 on a lower 18x multiple applied to updated Q5-Q8E EPS.

earnings_insights: GS FY27E/FY28E/FY29E EPS including SBC (estimate): $4.55 / $7.75 / $9.50, versus old $4.55 / $7.45 / $8.75. Excluding SBC (estimate): $5.05 / $8.25 / $10.00.
GS revenue estimates (estimate): FY28E $47,471.9mn (old $46,820.9mn), FY29E $53,432.2mn (old $52,025.6mn). FY26 reported revenue $27,914mn and EPS $2.93.

Management's CY27 Axiom revenue outlook of $20-$21bn is company guidance, with Power $6.0-$6.3bn and Cloud & Cooling $14.0-$14.7bn. Remainco FY27 adjusted EBIT margin is ~5.8% pro-forma at the guidance midpoint.
risk_factors: Investors may question the achievability of, or upside to, the targets, including the CY30 Axiom financial framework
Potential election-related datacenter uncertainty and permitting delays
geopolitical: The report notes US election results may cause things like datacenter permits to take longer, and that Flex's outlook factors in election-related datacenter uncertainty ahead of the mid-term election.

tension_points.bull_case: Management guided CY27 Axiom revenue of $20-$21bn with 95% covered by backlog and commitments, and described its outlook as conservative. GS says the CY27 CPI outlook is modestly ahead of its forecast.
tension_points.bear_case: GS expects investors will still question the achievability of, or upside to, the targets, including the CY30 Axiom framework. Some investors had expected more material upside before the mid-term election.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Permit delays or datacenter uncertainty following the US election results that cut into the CY27 Axiom revenue target.
